page_title: BOC 2-0 HEI | Bochum v Heidenheim 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' The resulting corner from Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) comes to nothing.
90+6' The game is interrupted now, Felix Passlack (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) is about to take a corner kick.
90+2' Substitution. Philipp Hofmann leaves the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Bamba (Bochum).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bochum players look gutted.
90' The Bochum players halt their celebrations as referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
89' Goal! Felix Passlack shows great vision to find Lukas Daschner (Bochum) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the roof of the net. 3:0.
88' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
87' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
85' Here is a change. Moritz Broschinski is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani de Wit (Bochum) is coming onto the pitch as Ibrahima Sissoko cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
83' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Patrick Drewes easily deals with the threat.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Problems for Frank Schmidt as Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Sirlord Conteh replaces him.
78' The game has come to an end for Maximilian Wittek. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jakov Medic (Bochum).
78' The ball is cleared after Matus Bero (Bochum) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
75' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
74' A poorly taken free kick by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
73' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
71' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) produces a good strike that sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
68' What a huge chance for Matus Bero (Bochum). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
68' A pass from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is intercepted by Patrick Drewes and the move breaks down.
66' One of the Heidenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
63' 9:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
60' Substitution. Thomas Keller did his best and is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
57' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
54' What was Matus Bero (Bochum) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
51' Felix Passlack (Bochum) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
50' Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
47' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
46' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) comes off for Marnon Busch.
46' Frank Schmidt has made a change at the break. Stefan Schimmer has come on in place of Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
46' Frank Schmidt makes a switch. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen is coming on in place of Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
43' The foul by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) was seen by Sven Jablonski who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
40' Dangerous play by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
38' 2 - 0 Matus Bero (Bochum) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
37' Matus Bero (Bochum) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
35' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:4.
31' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul after Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents.
30' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
29' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
27' Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
22' Bernardo (Bochum) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
20' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails miles wide of the right post!
17' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
16' The linesman signals that Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
15' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is penalised for holding. Sven Jablonski signals a set piece.
15' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Felix Passlack (Bochum).
13' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
12' Referee Sven Jablonski sees the trip by Matus Bero (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Heidenheim win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
11' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
8' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

6' 1 - 0 Ibrahima Sissoko sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.

4' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sven Jablonski with no other option than to blow for a foul.

4' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal.
4' There's an opportunity for Matus Bero (Bochum) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
3' An attempted cross from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bochum will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Sven Jablonski.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
